page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9ae.12xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by the AMD EPYC 9T95 processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a base frequency of 2.25 GHz. The instance provisions 48 dedicated vCPUs paired with 384.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:8 core-to-memory ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

Hardware capabilities include a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps. The instance provides no integrated local storage and contains zero GPUs, relying entirely on network-attached block storage for operating systems and persistence layers. Additionally, it allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating external routing configurations for internet egress and ingress.

Given the high memory footprint relative to execution threads, this instance profile is designed for RAM-intensive deployments. It suits production relational databases, in-memory caching solutions like Redis, large-scale data processing engines, and enterprise backend applications requiring sustained memory allocation without GPU acceleration.
